procedures.name: FirstTrue
procedures.source:
&Choice = 1
Do Case
  Case &Choice = 1
    Msg("first_true_first_case", status)
  Case &Choice >= 1
    Msg("first_true_second_case", status)
  Otherwise
    Msg("first_true_otherwise", status)
EndCase
Msg("first_true_after", status)

procedures.name: NoMatch
procedures.source:
&Choice = 3
Do Case
  Case &Choice = 1
    Msg("no_match_case_one", status)
  Case &Choice = 2
    Msg("no_match_case_two", status)
EndCase
Msg("no_match_fell_through", status)

procedures.name: Nested
procedures.source:
&Outer = 1
&Inner = 2
Do Case
  Case &Outer = 1
    Msg("nested_outer_first", status)
    Do Case
      Case &Inner = 1
        Msg("nested_inner_one", status)
      Case &Inner = 2
        Msg("nested_inner_two", status)
      Otherwise
        Msg("nested_inner_otherwise", status)
    EndCase
  Case &Outer = 2
    Msg("nested_outer_second", status)
  Otherwise
    Msg("nested_outer_otherwise", status)
EndCase
Msg("nested_after", status)

procedures.name: LaterHelper
procedures.source:
&Choice = 1
&Hits = 0
Do Case
  Case &Choice = 1
    Msg("later_helper_first_case", status)
  Case &Choice = Helper(&Hits)
    Msg("later_helper_second_case", status)
  Otherwise
    Msg("later_helper_otherwise", status)
EndCase
Print(&Hits)
